title: Evidence narrative
intro: This report describes recorded observations. Each fact links to the journal record it comes from.
heading.verify: How to check the original package
scene.records: Between {from} and {to}, the journal contains {n, plural, one{# record} few{# records} many{# records} other{# records}} in this scene.
collection.counts: The recorded event counts are: new messages {messages}, edits {edits}, deletion notices {deletions}, and messages absent on recheck {missing}.
limit.clock: Observation dates come from the recording computer; an independent time check is separate.
limit.recorded: These statements describe the journal's claims.
limit.coverage: Event counts cover the recorded intervals; confirmed collection periods are listed separately.
limit.omitted: An oversized payload value was omitted from the prose; consult the referenced original record.
limit.document: Document properties and signature checks shown here are recorded claims.
limit.gap: The journal records an interruption; its cause and the events during it come from other records.
limit.unknown: This event type has no dedicated narrative interpretation; its original record remains the source.
limit.truth: Messages are recorded as Telegram delivered them to this account.

expert.title: Expert report: draft
expert.draft: The verifier prepared this draft on the examiner's computer from the examiner's copy of the evidence package. The expert completes the blank fields and decides the final wording.
expert.jurisdiction.none: No jurisdiction selected. The expert adds the legal basis, the liability warning and local standards.
expert.jurisdiction.research: The legal references are a research aid. Confirm each one against the current official text before use.
expert.field.authority: Authority or official who ordered the examination; date of the order
expert.field.name: Expert: full name
expert.basis.duties: Rights and duties of the expert: {basis}
expert.basis.external_time: This result relies on the trusted root of the time-stamp authority or on Bitcoin block headers.
expert.contents: Required contents of the expert report in this jurisdiction
expert.declaration: Declaration required in the expert report
expert.questions: Questions put to the expert, as worded in the order
expert.material.package: Evidence package. SHA-256 computed during this examination: {sha}
expert.material.witness: Witness package. SHA-256 computed during this examination: {sha}
expert.material.fingerprint: SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key of the collection software, supplied by the examiner: {fingerprint}
expert.material.no_fingerprint: The examiner supplied no SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key of the collection software.
expert.material.records: The journal contains {records} records; {files} files were checked against the manifest.
expert.method.tool: Software: TgWitness {version}. SHA-256 of the verifier source used: {sha}.
expert.method.standards: Algorithms and formats checked, with their published specifications:
expert.std.sha256: SHA-256 hashes of records, files and the manifest: FIPS 180-4.
expert.std.ed25519: Ed25519 signatures of records and the manifest: RFC 8032.
expert.std.tsp: Time-stamp tokens: RFC 3161; certificate paths: RFC 5280.
expert.std.ots: OpenTimestamps proofs: checked against Bitcoin block headers.
expert.method.local: Digital-evidence standards issued or adopted in this jurisdiction:
expert.method.local_note: The expert states which of these standards the examination followed.
expert.procedure.repeat: Each check can be repeated on another copy of the evidence package with these commands. Obtain TRUSTED_COLLECTOR_FP and TRUSTED_WITNESS_FP through a channel independent of the evidence package.
expert.procedure.coverage: Recorded coverage: observed periods {periods}, recorded gaps {gaps}, message numbers not observed {unobserved}.
expert.bucket.computed.note: These results follow from the cryptographic checks. Anyone with the evidence package and the same inputs obtains the same results.
expert.bucket.conditional: Findings that depend on a stated condition
expert.bucket.conditional.note: Each result holds when its condition is met. Whether it is met is for the expert and the court to assess.
expert.status.unchecked: timestamp files present, not checked in this run
expert.cond.external_time: Time confirmed by a third party
expert.cond.signer: Signing key of the collection software
expert.cond.environment: Attested collection run (GitHub Actions or Intel TDX)
expert.condition.signer: Condition: the SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key was obtained before the examination through a channel independent of the evidence package.
expert.condition.checkpoint: Condition: the checkpoint was received before the evidence package, through another channel.
expert.condition.head_binding: Condition: the witness signing key is held by a party separate from the operator of the collection software, as the key-control record of the witness shows.
expert.condition.environment: Condition: the issuer of the attestation and the approved collection policy are trusted, and the attested run created the Telegram session itself.
expert.detail.integrity: Records checked: {records}; files checked: {files}. Their signatures and hashes match.
expert.detail.integrity_plain: All record signatures, the hash chain, the manifest and the file hashes were found to match.
expert.detail.signer_met: The signing key {fingerprint}… of the collection software matches the SHA-256 fingerprint supplied by the examiner.
expert.detail.signer_missing: The signing key {fingerprint}… of the collection software was not compared with a fingerprint obtained independently.
expert.detail.time_met: The last exported record existed by {time}.
expert.detail.time_qualified: The last exported record existed by {time}, according to a qualified eIDAS time stamp from {service}.
expert.detail.time_partial: Records 1–{through} existed by {time}; later records are outside this time bound.
expert.detail.time_unchecked: Timestamp proofs present: {count}. Repeat with --tsa-ca or --check-bitcoin to check them.
expert.detail.time_missing: The evidence package contains no external timestamp.
expert.detail.witness: A witness with a separate signing key retained records 1–{through} of {total}.
expert.detail.witness_missing: The examiner supplied no witness archive signed with a separate witness key.
expert.detail.checkpoint: Records 1–{through} of {total} match the checkpoint supplied by the examiner.
expert.detail.checkpoint_missing: The examiner supplied no retained checkpoint.
expert.detail.environment_met: Collection ran in the attested workflow {workflow}.
expert.detail.environment_partial: Intel TDX attestation reports were verified offline and bound to the signing key of the collection software. The deployed code is checked separately with python -m tgwitness.cloud verify.
expert.detail.environment_missing: No attested collection run was checked.
expert.annex.questions: Annex A. Questions for the order appointing the examination
expert.annex.questions.note: Each question the evidence package can answer is listed with the verification step that answers it.
expert.questions.answerable: Questions this evidence package can answer
expert.q.changed: Were the records changed after the collection software signed them?
expert.q.changed.check: Relevant check: the signatures of the records, the hash chain and the manifest.
expert.q.time: By what time did the records exist?
expert.q.time.check: Relevant check: external timestamps (RFC 3161, OpenTimestamps) and witness records.
expert.q.manifest: Do the files in the package match the signed manifest?
expert.q.manifest.check: Relevant check: SHA-256 of each file compared with the manifest.
expert.q.key: Were all records signed with one key, and is it the key whose SHA-256 fingerprint the court supplied?
expert.q.key.check: Relevant check: Ed25519 signatures and comparison with the SHA-256 fingerprint supplied by the court.
expert.q.coverage: Which periods were observed, and where are the recorded gaps?
expert.q.coverage.check: Relevant check: coverage records and missing message numbers.
expert.q.witness: Does the journal match an independently retained witness or checkpoint?
expert.q.witness.check: Relevant check: comparison of journal heads and checkpoints.
expert.run.receipt: Settings and inputs of this run: narrative-run.json, SHA-256 {sha}.
expert.run.repeat: This document contains no generation time. The same version, package and inputs produce the same HTML and JSON files.
expert.signature.cert: The expert may also sign this document with their own certificate. Electronic signatures in this jurisdiction: {law}.
expert.signature.cert_generic: The expert may also sign this document with their own certificate.
expert.signature.collector: The signing key of the collection software signs the journal; it does not sign this expert report.
expert.pdf.script: This passage uses a script without an installed PDF font; the HTML version shows it.
expert.open: Points the catalog could not confirm from an official text, in English; check them before use:
advice.translation: Recommendation: for court, file the English original with a certified or sworn translation into the court language. A sworn translator knows the local terminology and the formal requirements for court documents. Versions of this report in languages other than English are machine translations for orientation.
